title: floodhi-s2-benchmark: code and data for a wall-to-wall evaluation of FLOOD-HI and Sentinel-2 water indices (Rio Grande do Sul floods, May 2024)
description: Google Earth Engine scripts, Python analysis code, Earth Engine exports (class-conditional histograms, confusion counts, random-point samples and maps) and the spatial inputs (study domains and Directly Affected Area) used in the paper Assessing the added value of spectral-index fusion for Sentinel-2 flood mapping: A reproducible wall-to-wall evaluation of the 2024 Rio Grande do Sul State floods (Computers & Geosciences, under review). The archived exports reproduce every table of the paper, including the machine-readable Data S1.
